request.style: English, female jazz vocalist, warm and smooth, piano, upright bass, brushed drums, double bass, mellow mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the days of Joiakim the high priest stood
Heads of the fathers houses in the city found
From the exile we returned to the rebuilt place
To keep the order of the sacred grace

[Chorus]
Of Harim Adna is named in the list
Of Meraioth Helkai is the priest
Of the line of Merajot he leads the way
In the days of Joiakim each day

[Verse]
Jeshua fathered Joiakim in the record clear
Eliashib then Joiada through the years
Jonathan and Jaddua follow in line
Serving the temple in Jerusalem's shrine

[Chorus]
Of Harim Adna is named in the list
Of Meraioth Helkai is the priest
Of the line of Merajot he leads the way
In the days of Joiakim each day

[Bridge]
Seraiah and Jeremiah had their own heads
Meraiah and Hananiah standing in steads
Ezra had Meshullam Amariah had his own
Jehohanan serving in the holy throne

[Verse]
Malluch had Jonathan Shebaniah had Joseph
Harim had Adna keeping the promise
Meraioth had Helkai in the book of Nehemiah
Preserving the priestly line for the family

[Chorus]
Of Harim Adna is named in the list
Of Meraioth Helkai is the priest
Of the line of Merajot he leads the way
In the days of Joiakim each day

[Outro]
Of Meraioth Helkai is the priest
Head of the fathers houses in the light
